data.narrative:
Ethos Space is a seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Brogan BamBrogan, Jeff Overbeek, and Ross Centers. The valuation landscape for this sector includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, with leading private companies including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Standard valuation triangulation methods are constrained by data limitations. Peer-median analysis is not applicable: while 14 same-sector peers exist in Space & Aerospace, the dataset contains zero companies matching Ethos's stage, adjacent stages, or similar valuation tiers, falling short of the minimum three-datapoint threshold needed for statistical reliability. Public-comp anchoring is similarly inapplicable because Ethos's revenue is not on file—standard for private companies at stealth stage—and therefore cannot be multiplied against the sector P/S median of 24.4x observed across the 6 public comparables.

This analysis cannot support a specific valuation range without either (1) disclosed or estimated revenue for the target, or (2) a sufficiently dense cohort of same-stage private seed raises in Space & Aerospace. The key uncertainties blocking valuation are revenue-side opacity and sparse comparable transaction data at the seed stage. Any valuation attribution at this point would be speculative and should be revisited once additional operational or fundraising disclosures emerge.
